baselineDisplay.title: Excuse Me
baselineDisplay.question: Whose handbag is it?
baselineDisplay.text:
Whose handbag is it?

Excuse me!
Yes?
Is this your handbag?
Pardon?
Is this your handbag?
Yes it is.
Thank you very much.

是的，它是。
非常感谢您。
